description: Norfolk Establishes Strategy for Coastal Resilience is a case study listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Norfolk Department of City Planning; Norfolk City Planning Commission. At the mouth of Chesapeake Bay, the city of Norfolk, Virginia, lies within ten feet of sea level. It's taking steps to envision and implement a resilient future. Coverage: Virginia (2017). The toolkit gives Virginia as the location, 2017 as the year. The listed link gives the documented application. Access is free of charge and open.
